comparison.objective: Fill a bath using a safe cold-first and hot-off-first tap sequence, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Quarter-turn lever sequencing differs from small recessed-tool alignment, captive-screw torque, fine collar manipulation, and iterative response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Success requires safe tap order and reaching the fill line, with zero if hot runs alone; the candidate requires two bounded-energy stops without bottoming, overload, rebound, or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve ordered controls, but tap sequencing and simulated fill do not test adjustment locking or dynamic damping performance.
